workflows.name: Select the application template
workflows.statement: Select the application template using the URL, stored template, site setting and default in precedence order.

workflows.name: Start or resume from Home
workflows.statement: Explicitly starting a new application from Home clears the prior application draft, saved-application handle and transient session flags before entering Membership, so an expired inactivity deadline cannot carry into the new application. Continue application opens the resume flow and preserves the existing draft. Ordinary field activity and navigation cannot revive an expired session.

workflows.name: Resolve the next participating application page
workflows.statement: Resolve the next page using the page resolver or participating application order.

workflows.name: Advance the route or single-page section after save
workflows.statement: After successful continuation, advance the route or single-page section with transition feedback.
